incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: GPU allocation errors in brazilsouth affecting inference autoscaler (P0) - queue growth observed
Sofia Marin: grabbing it, oncall takeover. ETA to look: 2m
Ethan Cho: seeing steady queue increase on brazilsouth pool, autoscaler attempted scale-up at 12:07Z and got repeated allocation failures
Priya Patel: logs show Azure returned quota errors: "AllocationFailed: The subscription has reached the allowed number of GPUs for region brazilsouth"
Carlos Gomez: confirmed, sample from runtime logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:07:42Z ERROR allocation_manager: allocate failed: AzureError(AllocationFailed) - ResourceQuotaExceeded: Requested cores for 'Standard_NC6s_v3' exceed permitted quota. allowed: 8, requested_total: 16
```
Megan Li: customer impact: 15% of hosted inference requests are delayed >5s; tail latency spiking, some 503s after queue timeout. Incident classified P0.
Sofia Marin: quick mitigation plan: 1) try soft-fallback to lower-GPU variant in region for non-sensitive tenants 2) reroute some traffic to us-east1 3) open quota request with Azure support
Ethan Cho: implementing 1 and 2 now. Deploying a runtime toggle to prefer smaller instance types and lower batch sizes in brazilsouth.
Priya Patel: opening SR with Azure (ticket created) - reference: SR#AZ-2026-9981. Azure support-bot acked initial request: "Investigating quota increase options"
azure-support-bot: Support ticket AZ-2026-9981 created. Current estimate: 6-12 hours for quota increase unless expedited.
Carlos Gomez: while waiting, we need to reduce pressure. Changing autoscaler policy to allow fallback allocation to smaller GPU SKUs and enabling prefix-KV caching to cut repeat token compute.
Sofia Marin: @Ethan, are there safe model variants to route to (fp16 quantized smaller models)?
Ethan Cho: yes - we have a 70% throughput compatible quantized v2 variant in brazilsouth and an identical model in us-east1. Routing changes done: 30% -> us-east1, rest prefer local quantized variant.
Megan Li: posting to status.redwood.ai: initial note drafted. Marking impacted as "Increased latency in South America (brazilsouth) - partial mitigation in progress"
Sofia Marin: handoff to infra for Azure quota escalation and cross-region routing orchestration. Priya - continue support thread, escalate to Microsoft account team for potential emergency quota lift.
Priya Patel: pinging account team + partner rep. Asking for emergency increase to reach requested 16 GPUs. Message: "Production P0 - allocation failures causing customer-facing latency"
pagerduty-bot: On-call escalation: Priya Patel -> Sofia Marin acknowledged at 12:12Z.
Carlos Gomez: quick config snippet used to force smaller SKUs and lower batch sizes:
```yaml
autoscaler_policy:
  preferred_instance_types: [Standard_NC6s_v3, Standard_NC4s_v3]
  allow_fallback: true
  batch_size_override: 1
```
Ethan Cho: rolled config at 12:15Z. Observed immediate drop in queue growth rate. Latency moving from 95th 4.8s -> 3.2s.
Sofia Marin: can we drain the longest waiting queues by briefly increasing request timeouts and returning partial results for experimental routes? Need to avoid 503s.
Carlos Gomez: implemented request timeout bump for non-critical tenants, enabled partial response flag. That reduced 503s by ~60%.
Megan Li: updated status page: "Mitigation implemented: traffic partially rerouted; performance improved. Azure quota request in progress."
Priya Patel: Azure account team responded: "We can expedite to a temporary quota increase to 24 GPUs if you provide justification and impact details." Asked for approval.
Sofia Marin: approved. Priya, please accept expedited increase and confirm when applied. Also coordinate with billing to ensure temporary allocation is within contract.
Priya Patel: accepted on support chat. Azure support: "Temporary quota increase applied - visible in portal now" (12:28Z)
azure-support-bot: Quota change completed: Standard_NC_series GPUs increased to 24 in brazilsouth as of 12:28Z.
Ethan Cho: autoscaler re-tried pending scale-ups; allocations succeeded and new nodes registered at 12:33Z. Queue drained steadily by 12:40Z.
Sofia Marin: monitoring - watching for regressions. Status: restored capacity, tail latency back to normal for majority of requests; still monitoring slow-moving tenants.
Megan Li: drafting customer-facing post-incident with timeline and mitigation steps. Will include: what happened, immediate mitigations (routing + smaller SKUs), and follow-up actions.
Carlos Gomez: ACTIONS (short):
- follow up with Azure account team to convert temp quota to permanent (Priya)
- add autoscaler logic to detect quota errors and proactively lower batch sizes / route traffic (Ethan)
- add playbook entry for brazilsouth quota exhaustion (Sofia)
- postmortem ping (Megan)
Sofia Marin: handing back to infra-oncall for continued monitoring. Thanks team.
pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved (manual) by Sofia Marin at 12:52Z.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED - root cause: region GPU quota exhausted; autoscaler lacked graceful degraded mode on quota errors.
Megan Li: scheduling postmortem for 2026-03-16 16:00Z, will include logs + timeline + customer comms draft.
